post_dispatch_uncertainty.finding: Malformed/mismatched receipts, transport completion uncertainty, post-commit native errors, failed independent read-back, validator exceptions or state-chain construction failures could otherwise return an error without permanently blocking later mutation.
post_dispatch_uncertainty.resolution: Any unverified condition after native dispatch begins now latches STATE_UNCERTAIN. Only N5-proven pre-write typed refusals are non-uncertain; STATE_DRIFT remains a separate blocking state.
post_dispatch_uncertainty.verification: Focused TDD covers malformed receipt, COMMIT_INTEGRITY_FAIL, transport failure, read-back failure, validator failure and chain-build failure.

independent_semantic_validation.finding: PID-level delta alone could accept wrong requested geometry or an update that also changed the target style/layer/hierarchy.
independent_semantic_validation.resolution: N6 independently matches create/update LINE geometry to ActionSpec, preserves the update target envelope, requires invariant document/style-resource state, validates affected PID against the independent delta and still detects new duplicate geometry.
independent_semantic_validation.verification: Focused TDD plus live create/update/delete chain acceptance.

journal_failure.finding: A failed append after a verified rollback could leave the in-memory executor able to continue without complete audit evidence.
journal_failure.resolution: Journal append failure now blocks the executor; post-commit journal failure is classified STATE_UNCERTAIN and non-commit evidence failure is JOURNAL_FAILED.

limitations: N6 wraps only the N5 fixed-schema LINE create/update/delete surface; it does not broaden native mutation capability.
N4/N5 semantic extraction remains bounded to active current space plus referenced block definitions/content and MaxSnapshotEntities=32.
Native relation/topology extraction is still empty in the current bridge, so N6 does not claim topology validation beyond the available snapshot data.
N6 JSONL journals are append-only per run and deliberately refuse silent resume from a pre-existing non-empty journal; explicit crash/restart resume is future work.
A deterministic validation failure discovered after N5 has already committed latches STATE_UNCERTAIN; N6 does not perform R1/R2 compensation or post-commit recovery.
N7 two-phase commit integrity/recovery is not implemented or opened by this checkpoint.
The staged native bridge remains internal; COM/ezdxf remains the supported public migration baseline.
decision: N6 CLOSED / LIVE PASS for semantic delta, allowed-effects/requested-geometry validation, state-chain continuity, duplicate detection, manual-drift refusal, append-only per-run journal and post-dispatch uncertainty latching over the accepted N5 LINE surface. STOP implementation after N6; N7 remains NOT STARTED. Next activity is audit plus a separate three-agent implementation plan only.
